assessments.reasoning: The pinned SPDX JSON-LD links the document to the 2.0 license node and that node to CreationInfo. The boolean and Eclipse legal links are properties of the identified license. The graph therefore supports every release-scoped listing element in the claim.

challenge.method: Exchanged the 2.0 graph for the 1.0 graph at the same commit and followed each document's root to its own license node.
challenge.results: The 1.0 graph agrees on creator, encoding version and false deprecation flag. It fails on root identifier, license name and edition-specific Eclipse link. Only the 2.0 graph supports this mapping.

limitations: CreationInfo.createdBy points to creatoragent/3_29_0, identifying apparent License List release 3.29.0. Its specVersion 3.0.1 describes the encoding.

The byte pin applies to the SPDX JSON-LD. Its licenseText uses typographic quotation marks where the Eclipse plaintext uses straight quotes, and its standardLicenseTemplate includes matching variables. Listing status establishes neither project policy nor a project's Secondary License selection.
reasoning: At SPDX data commit 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48, rootElement identifies http://spdx.org/licenses/EPL-2.0. The matching expandedlicensing_ListedLicense has name Eclipse Public License 2.0 and expandedlicensing_isDeprecatedLicenseId set to the JSON boolean false. Its expandedlicensing_seeAlso includes https://www.eclipse.org/legal/epl-2.0 and https://www.eclipse.org/legal/epl-v20.html.
